description: Vector/embedding configuration contract for Kaji's tool retriever and document RAG.

embedding.dimension: provider-determined; not fixed by the SDK. Cached payloads record their dimension and are rejected on mismatch or non-positive values.

toolRetriever.selectionRule: tools with similarity >= threshold, ordered by score descending, capped at topK

constraints: all cached embeddings in one payload must share one non-zero dimension
cache identity is provider:model:generation; stale mixed-model payloads are rejected

documentRag.dimensionPolicy: chunks whose embedding dimension differs from the index are skipped at search time
